title: Flutter apps
description: For a Flutter app: a committed pubspec.lock, analysis with the Flutter lints, checked formatting, no secret in the app, the symbol files of obfuscated builds and a current Flutter SDK.

sources.title: Dart docs, what not to commit: pubspec.lock

rules.instruction: Commit `pubspec.lock` for the app, so that changes to transitive dependencies are explicit. Do not commit it for a reusable package published for other projects.
rules.verification: task verify checks that `pubspec.lock` exists; also check that a dependency change updates it in the same change.

rules.instruction: Keep `analysis_options.yaml` next to `pubspec.yaml`, include a lint set such as `package:flutter_lints/flutter.yaml`, and run `flutter analyze` in CI.
rules.verification: task verify checks that `analysis_options.yaml` includes the Flutter or Dart lints; also check that `flutter analyze` reports nothing new on the change.

rules.instruction: Check formatting in CI with `dart format -o none --set-exit-if-changed .`, which changes no file and exits with 1 when one is not formatted.
rules.verification: Run `dart format -o none --set-exit-if-changed .` and check that it exits with 0.

rules.instruction: Store no secret in the app: obfuscation with `--obfuscate` only renames symbols, it does not encrypt resources or prevent reverse engineering.
rules.verification: Review the constants, assets and build settings the change adds and check that none holds a key or a secret meant for a server.

rules.instruction: When a release is built with `--obfuscate --split-debug-info=DIR`, back up the symbol files written to DIR with the release, so that `flutter symbolize` can read its stack traces.
rules.verification: For an obfuscated release, check that the symbol files of that build are stored with it.

rules.instruction: Keep the Flutter SDK and the app's dependencies current, since updates can fix security defects; when a dependency is pinned to a version, check it regularly for security updates.
rules.verification: Check the Flutter version used by CI against the current stable release, and for each pinned dependency, the date it was last reviewed.
